statement: The retained component Zσ, with its Frobenius action, evaluation bundles at the chosen cyclic tuple, and singular-support map, admits the model Zσ ≃  (µ−1 (0))∧ unst/J  . (3.7) Here unst is the inverse image of the origin under V → V//J, and completion is along this invariant null fiber. In this model: (i) the singularity scheme has points (x, z) satisfying µ(x) = 0 and zx = 0, with z ∈ j; (ii) the support condition defined by Y is the condition that the image of z under j ,→ b g belongs to Y ; 12 (iii) every evaluation representation of K = b Gd is the bundle associated to its restriction along J ,→ K; Frobenius has constant cyclic transport on these bundles; (iv) after removing the scalars q1/2 on deformation points and q−1 on singular points, Frobenius is a linear automorphism of the moment-map data, normalizing J and the framed representation labels. Its eigenvalues on these normalized linear data have modulus one. The meaning of Frobenius on Hom complexes in (iv) is fixed explicitly in Lemma 3.5 below.
